question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Isn't **__knowledge__** supposed to make life sweeter and happier?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Wisdom**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word '**knowledge**' is '**wisdom**'.
 
• **Knowledge -** information, understanding, or skills that you get from experience or education. (ज्ञान)
 
 
• *Example: Reading books and attending seminars are great ways to gain **knowledge** about different topics.*
 
 
 
• **Wisdom** **-** the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment. (बुद्धि)
 
 
• *Example: With age comes **wisdom**, and he has become wiser over the years.*
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Wisdom.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Profession** - a paid occupation, especially one that involves prolonged training and a formal qualification. (व्यवसाय)
 
• **Curriculum** - the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college. (पाठ्यक्रम)
 
• **Superiority** - the state of being better than or superior to something or someone else. (बढ़त)
